sampling: One shuffled OMPAL training-root pass each epoch; pair each batch with a shuffled length-bucketed native batch, cycling with reshuffle. Record native repetitions separately from unique roots.
nativeLoss: Mean of three complete sequence CTC losses, each normalized by provided sequence length. No expected-target conditioning.
ompalLoss: Per component mean of present expert-correct and expert-error group means; mean of components with known labels. Unknown components have zero gradient, including all-unknown batches; domain weights remain fixed.
checkpointSelection: Minimum balanced signed CTC calibration loss including epoch zero; preserve all eight epochs regardless of outcome.
